criteria: Atopic dermatitis (age 6 months+): moderate to severe AD AND prior high-potency topical corticosteroid OR topical calcineurin inhibitor (e.g., pimecrolimus, tacrolimus), or intolerance/contraindication.

CRSwNP (age 12+): used with a daily intranasal corticosteroid and inadequate control on maximum tolerated intranasal steroid. AFRS (age 6+): diagnosis plus prior sino-nasal surgery.
COPD with eosinophils >=300 cells/uL in prior 12 months (age 18+): inadequate control on ICS plus LABA plus LAMA, or LABA-LAMA if ICS contraindicated.

Prurigo nodularis (age 18+): diagnosis, prescribed by or with a dermatologist, allergist, or immunologist. Bullous pemphigoid (18+): biopsy/serologic diagnosis plus prior high-potency topical or oral steroid.
Eosinophilic esophagitis (age 1+, 15 kg+): biopsy with >=15 eosinophils/HPF in 2+ regions, >=2 dysphagia episodes/week, inadequate control on one guideline therapy (high-dose PPI or topical steroid).
Chronic spontaneous urticaria (age 2+): symptomatic despite at least 2 weeks of H1 antihistamine, and H1 antihistamine continued with Dupixent.
